snippet.title: That sausage museum game trailer 2024
snippet.description:
Flip-flop, roll and fling your way through a wacky art museum as a clumsy sausage on the run. Dodge weird obstacles, pull off ridiculous stunts, and try not to fall all the way down as you escape.

Available to wishlist on steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230820/That_sausage_museum_game/
